battle.name: 霍姆斯起義
battle.brief: 公元854年，伊巴德派在北非納富薩山區的霍姆斯城舉兵反抗阿格拉布王朝。阿格拉布軍自蓋爾特海沿岸集結，圍攻依岩而建的霍姆斯堡寨；羅馬扭力式投石機的技術譜系，正是圍城中使用來砸擊城牆與塔樓的攻城器械原型。圍城以守軍潰退、城池陷落告終，餘眾退入山區與澤爾巴島。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 霍姆斯起義是公元854年北非伊弗里基亞西部納富薩山區一場伊巴德派反抗阿格拉布王朝的起義，交戰地域在今利比亞的霍姆斯城（阿拉伯語 خومس，拉丁轉寫 Chomsus）周邊山地，即蓋爾特海峽內陸、納富薩台地的西緣。統治一方是800年由阿拔斯哈里發任命、駐節凱魯萬的阿拉伯裔世襲總督政權，其疆域大致相當於今日突尼斯全境，加上阿爾及利亞東部與利比亞的沿海地帶，內陸柏柏爾地區則以附庸與徵稅方式治理。軍力由四部分組成：以伊本·阿格拉布家族為核心、招募自伊拉克與阿拉伯部落的常備騎兵哈拉敦；按整支部族徵發的附庸軍，主要是則納塔、麥斯木達等支系的柏柏爾人；分駐各城與邊境要地的黑人士兵與守備隊；以及一支控制地中海的艦隊，負責把糧食、攻城器械與軍械從沿海基地運入山區。指揮系統以埃米爾為最高統帥，輔以掌文書的書記官與教法法官，部落軍由各部族自己的首領率領，埃米爾直屬的騎兵與禁衛是全軍骨幹。起義一方是納富薩山中以霍姆斯為中心的一批山地村落社區，信仰屬哈瓦利吉派中的伊巴德派，與建於塔希爾特的伊巴德派伊馬目國相互呼應，澤爾巴島的地中海社群是他們的海外支點。這一方沒有常備軍，組織依據是社區的奈基卜與長老會議，宣教由穆瓦利與阿明四處傳播，軍力是自備武器的山地民兵與石砌堡寨；由於阿格拉布當局把伊巴德派定為退教者，其公開集會、繳納丁稅與持有武裝在法律上一律被禁止，衝突因此自始帶有宗教與行政雙重性質。
countriesEn: The Khoms rising was an Ibadi revolt against the Aghlabid dynasty in the Nafusa mountains of western Ifriqiya in North Africa, fought in the country around the town of Khoms in present-day Libya (Arabic خومس, Latin Chomsus), on the western edge of the Nafusa plateau above the Gulf of Sirte. The side in power was the hereditary Arab governorship established in 800 by appointment of the Abbasid caliph and seated at Kairouan; its territory corresponded roughly to the whole of modern Tunisia together with eastern Algeria and the coastal belt of Libya, while the Berber interior was governed through clientage and taxation. Its military strength had four parts: the standing cavalry known as the Khalladun, recruited from Iraq and from the Arab tribes and centred on the household of the Ibn al-Aghlab; client levies raised whole tribes at a time, above all the Berbers of the Zenata and Masmuda branches; black infantry and garrison troops stationed in the towns and at the frontier posts; and a fleet holding the Mediterranean, which carried grain, siege engines and munitions from the coastal bases into the mountains. The command system made the emir the supreme commander, assisted by a secretary of the vizierial type and by the qadi, while tribal contingents were led by their own chiefs; the emir's own cavalry and household guard were the skeleton of the army. The side that rose was a cluster of mountain village communities centred on Khoms in the Nafusa, Ibadi in faith within the Kharijite grouping, in correspondence with the Ibadi imamate founded at Tahert, with the Mediterranean Ibadi communities of Djerba as their overseas point of support. This side had no standing army: its organisation rested on the community's naqib, the arbitrator in matters of religious law, and on councils of elders; propagation was carried by the wali and the amin who travelled from place to place; and its fighting strength consisted of mountain militia equipped at their own expense and of stone-built strongholds. Because the Aghlabid authorities classed the Ibadis as apostates, their public assemblies, their payment of tribute and their bearing of arms were all forbidden by law, and the conflict thus bore a religious and an administrative character from the very first.
people: 留下姓名的多數來自統治一方。埃米爾阿布·易卜拉欣·穆罕默德·伊本·阿格拉布（在位825年至851年）是阿格拉布王朝在位最久的君主，在他手上王朝完成了對伊弗里基亞主要城市的接管，並把突尼斯南部的柏柏爾人納入附庸體系；其子阿布爾·阿巴斯·艾哈邁德（在位851年至856年）執政的第五年，正是起義爆發之年；其弟阿布·易卜拉欣·艾哈邁德（在位856年至875年）後來以平定納富薩最後的伊巴德抵抗而見稱，多數編年把圍城的指揮功勞記在這一系埃米爾名下。朝廷中還有掌文書的書記官與教法法官，兩人在點算軍資、調配部族兵與主持交涉上扮演實際角色；部落首領如柏柏爾各支族的長老，則各自率兵加入或倒戈，直接決定了山區戰役的走向。起義一方的領袖姓名沒有在留存文獻中穩定保存下來：伊巴德派社群習慣以奈基卜與宣教者穆瓦利的名義行事，後世敘述又常把整場起義記在霍姆斯的伊巴德人名下，因此可以確定的只是，起義背後有伊巴德派教法層面的協調者，也有塔希爾特的伊馬目國在精神與物資上的支持，至於領袖個人的事跡多已散失。兵將姓名幾乎全部不傳，這本身就是這場戰爭在正統王朝編年中份量的說明。主要的史料來源是十四世紀的伊本·赫勒敦，他在《緒論》與《史論》中轉述了今天已佚的九世紀阿格拉布編年，這是外界對854年圍城細節幾乎唯一的依據；十至十一世紀的巴克里在《諸王與諸國之書》中從柏柏爾人的角度補上了另一段背景。
peopleEn: The names that survive come mostly from the side in power. The emir Abu Ibrahim Muhammad ibn al-Aghlab, who reigned from 825 to 851, was the longest-ruling of the Aghlabid sovereigns; under him the dynasty completed its seizure of the principal cities of Ifriqiya and drew the Berbers of southern Tunisia into the client system. His son Abu'l-Abbas Ahmad, on the throne from 851 to 856, was in his fifth regnal year when the rising broke out. Ahmad's brother Abu Ibrahim Ahmad, who reigned from 856 to 875, later became known for putting down the last Ibadi resistance in the Nafusa, and most of the chronicles assign the command of the siege to this line of Aghlabid emirs. At court there were also the secretary who handled the paperwork and the qadi; between them they counted the military resources, shuffled the tribal contingents and conducted the negotiations, and so they played a real part in the campaign. The chiefs of the tribes, the elders of the several Berber branches, brought their own men in or turned them, and it was their choices that decided how the fighting in the mountains went. The name of the leader on the rebel side has not been preserved with any stability in the documents that survive: Ibadi communities were in the habit of acting in the name of the naqib and of the preaching wali, and later narratives tend to ascribe the whole rising to the Ibadi people of Khoms, so that what can be established is only that there was an organiser on the plane of Ibadi religious law behind the rising, and that the Ibadi imamate at Tahert supported it in spirit and in material aid, while the personal doings of the leader himself are largely lost. Almost no names of officers and soldiers are transmitted, and that in itself tells us what weight this war carried in the dynastic chronicles. The principal source is the fourteenth-century Ibn Khaldun, whose Muqaddimah and Kitab al-Ibar carry an abstract of the ninth-century Aghlabid annals that no longer exist, and that is almost the only basis for what is known of the siege of 854; the tenth- and eleventh-century al-Bakri, in his Book of the Kings and the Kingdoms, supplies a further stretch of background from the Berber side.
kits: 卡面上這件兵器是羅馬扭力式投石機，機械結構的定型一般繫於公元前三世紀的羅馬共和末期與帝國早期，維特魯維奧斯在《建築十書》第十卷留下的扭力束臂、投臂末端繫兜的記載，是後世重建此類機器的首要依據。它的價值在於把人力絞盤儲存的彈簧勢能一次性轉化成投射物的動能：發射石彈而非箭矢，單發破壞力遠高於任何弓弩，一發足以在城牆上砸出缺口。它在這場戰役裡的位置是攻城序列中的火力核心：羅馬與晚期拜占庭早已把這類扭力式投射機帶入北非的軍械傳統，九世紀的阿格拉布工程師所倚仗的，正是同一條技術譜系上改用木與繩索製造的曼加內克式拋石機，發明者的姓名不必考究，機器的血緣卻是一脈相承。細節須說明：留存文獻只把攻城器械概括為撞槌、塔樓與拋石機，沒有指明霍姆斯城下所用機器的具體形制，因此把卡面的羅馬投石機直接指認為圍城所用那一具並不嚴謹，能夠確定的只是它所屬的機械類別。攻城一方還有：撞槌，沿架在土壘上的斜坡推行，直接撞擊城牆下段；可移動塔樓，由人力或絞盤推動，居高臨下射擊城頭守軍並掩護撞槌；以及配給步卒的弓與標槍，用於封鎖城牆缺口、壓制守軍出擊。守軍一方以地勢換裝備：霍姆斯堡寨依岩築台，牆體取山石壘砌，守軍憑高處以石塊、弓箭與標槍向下打擊，坡面狹窄使攻城器械難以展開，這也是圍城能拖長的技術前提。防護方面，阿拉伯式彎弓與輕型複合弓、柄部纏皮的小圓盾、鑲片皮甲與鎖子甲的混合防護，都是當時北非軍隊的常見裝束；馬匹以阿拉伯與北非本地種為主，後勤靠駱駝與驢隊沿海岸公路輸送，再以人力往山裡背負。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman torsion stone-thrower, the onager. The final shaping of the machine is generally tied to the late Republic and the early Empire, to the third century BC, and the account of the torsion bundle, the throwing arm and the sling at the end of the arm that Vitruvius left in the tenth book of his De architectura is the primary basis on which later generations reconstructed machines of this family. The value of the machine lies in the fact that it converts once and for all into the momentum of a projectile the spring energy stored by a windlass turned by human muscle: it throws a stone rather than an arrow, its destructive power in a single shot far exceeds that of any bow, and one shot is enough to breach a curtain wall. In this campaign its place was at the heart of the siege sequence as a source of firepower. Rome and the later Byzantines had already carried this family of torsion projectile engines into the military tradition of North Africa, and the engineers of the ninth-century Aghlabids relied on precisely the same technical pedigree, in the form of the mangonel-type stone-thrower built of timber and rope in the Islamic world. There is no need to establish the name of the inventor; the lineage of the machine is what matters. One detail must be stated: the surviving documents describe siege engines only in general terms, as a battering ram, towers and stone-throwers, and they do not identify the precise type of the machines used below Khoms, so it would not be rigorous to declare the Roman onager on the card to be the very engine that worked at the siege; what can be established is the class of machine to which it belonged. The besiegers had besides the battering ram, pushed forward along a ramp built of packed earth so as to strike the lower courses of the wall; the movable tower, moved by manpower or by winch, from which the defenders on the parapet could be shot at and under cover of which the ram advanced; and, for the foot, bows and javelins used to seal the breaches in the wall and to check the sorties of the garrison. The defending side exchanged equipment for ground: the stronghold of Khoms was built on rock, its walls laid up of mountain stone, and the garrison struck downward with stones, arrows and javelins from the height; the narrowness of the slope made it hard to deploy siege engines, and that too was a technical precondition for the long duration of the siege. In the way of protection, the Arab recurved bow and light composite bows, small round shields with leather-wrapped grips, and mixed protection of splinted leather and mail were the common dress of the armies of North Africa at the time. The horses were of Arab and local North African stock, and the rear was supplied by camel and donkey trains along the coastal road, with the loads then carried up into the hills on men's backs.
tactics: 從當時同類圍城的做法，以及伊本·赫勒敦留下的零星記述，可以重建出大致步驟。第一步是起義如何在山區成形：伊巴德派的宣教網絡在村社之間傳遞消息，奈基卜與穆瓦利在清真寺與集市上召集人眾，霍姆斯因地勢險要而成為天然中心，鄰近村社的民兵在數日內集結。第二步是阿格拉布方面的應對：埃米爾自凱魯萬調兵，先以騎兵急行封住通往山區的幾條道路，再命各附庸部族按編制集結，攻城所需的重裝與糧秣則由艦隊自的黎波里與米蘇拉塔一線運上陸。第三步是進軍：從海岸進入納富薩山只能走少數谷道，騎兵在寬處展開成縱隊，在窄處拉成長列，步兵與攻城車隊夾在中間，這樣的隊形本身限制了速度，也使後勤成為最脆弱的一環。第四步是圍城部署：攻城軍在山下展開封鎖線，營地設在攻城器械能反覆運轉的位置，同時以騎兵巡邏山道，斷絕城內的樵採與糧食來源，並攔截可能從別的山口滲出的援兵。第五步是工程作業：把拋石機一類的機具沿土壘斜坡逐步抬到可以平射城牆的高度，搭起撞槌與塔樓，改變攻擊點；守軍則利用居高臨下的地勢射擊暴露在外的機具與工匠，拋石機在此情境中成為攻城方最貴重的資產，也最容易被城頭的火力直接擊毀。第六步是攻堅與崩解：城牆被撞槌與投石砸開缺口之後，兩軍在缺口處反覆拉鋸，圍城方每次投入的兵力有限，傷亡難以補充，而被圍方的石彈與標槍消耗著城下的護盾與攻城塔，城內糧食與守軍的士氣同時下降。第七步是結局：史家一致的印象是圍城歷時甚久，攻城方最終靠更多的器械投入與更長的封鎖線換來城門被打開的結果，守軍的編制瓦解，倖存者退往更高的山區與澤爾巴島方向，抵抗的組織架構隨之散入各地。
tacticsEn: From the practice of comparable sieges of the time, and from the scattered notices left by Ibn Khaldun, the course of affairs can be reconstructed in outline. The first step is how the rising took shape in the mountains: the network of Ibadi preachers carried word between the village communities, the naqib and the wali called people together in the mosques and in the markets, Khoms became a natural centre because of the strength of its site, and the militia of the neighbouring villages came together within days. The second step is the Aghlabid response: the emir drew troops from Kairouan, first sending cavalry at a gallop to close the roads into the mountains, then ordering the client tribes to assemble by their contingents, while the heavy equipment and provisions for the siege were brought ashore by the fleet along the Tripoli and Misrata line. The third step is the advance: only a few valleys lead from the coast into the Nafusa, and there the cavalry deployed into column where the ground allowed and stretched into a long file where it did not, with the foot and the siege wagons in between; a formation of that kind limits the speed of the column and makes the supply line the most fragile part of it. The fourth step is the deployment of the siege: the besiegers opened a line of investment below the mountain, camped where their engines could be worked over and over, sent cavalry along the mountain paths to cut the garrison's access to firewood and grain and to intercept any relief that might come out of another pass. The fifth step is the engineering: the stone-throwers and their kind were raised step by step along earthen ramps until they could shoot level with the curtain wall; the ram and the towers went up; the points of attack changed. The defenders answered with the height, shooting at the engines and the craftsmen exposed below them, so that the stone-thrower was at once the besiegers' most valuable asset and the target most easily broken by fire from the parapet. The sixth step is the assault and the breaking: once the ram and the stones had opened a breach, the two sides fought back and forth at it, the besiegers committing limited numbers each time and finding their losses hard to make good, while the stones and javelins of the besieged wore away the mantlets and the siege towers below the walls, and the food and the morale of the garrison fell together. The seventh step is the end: the impression left by the historians alike is that the siege lasted a long time, and that the besiegers finally bought an opened gate with more engines committed and a longer line of blockade; the organisation of the garrison dissolved, the survivors withdrew towards the higher valleys and towards Djerba, and the structure of the resistance scattered into separate places.
data: 可核對的數字分三類。第一類是編年所載的年份與事件的相對次序：起義發生於公元854年，無論阿格拉布編年殘卷還是後世阿拉伯史家的敘述，都把此事放在阿格拉布王朝第九任埃米爾阿布爾·阿巴斯·艾哈邁德執政期間，與其弟阿布·易卜拉欣·艾哈邁德平定納富薩的戰役相銜接；確切的月份沒有任何文獻記載，卡面標出的九月是依北非秋季徵作與圍城季節的通行安排推得，屬於推定而非記載。距離與位置是可查的：霍姆斯在的黎波里西南約一百一十公里，位於納富薩台地西緣，是村落分布的最西端，鄰近地中海海岸的米蘇拉塔與塔爾胡納是攻城軍在沿海的後勤基地。圍城時間在各家記載中從數月到一年以上不等，沒有更精確的說法可採信。兵員數字完全不可考：阿格拉布各代的野戰軍都由部族分遣隊組成，編年只留下多至不可勝數一類的形容，沒有可核的總數；一般而言，阿格拉布王朝的核心騎兵常備兵力在數千之數，加上柏柏爾附庸步兵與黑人士兵，實際作戰兵力當遠高於此，但沒有任何可靠的逐次統計可以套用到854年。第二類是兵器與器械的技術數據：羅馬投石機一類的扭力式拋射機，操作組通常為八至十五人，投擲石彈的重量在數十公斤上下，有效射程約一百五十至三百公尺，精度隨機具狀態與操作人員而變，維特魯維奧斯留下的扭力束數與臂長比值是重建這類機器的通行依據。第三類是時代的結構性數字：阿格拉布王朝自800年立國至909年亡國，歷九任埃米爾；與之對抗的伊巴德派伊馬目國建於777年的塔希爾特，至909年方告終結；九世紀末至十世紀，伊巴德社群在澤爾巴島組成詹哈拉特聯盟；所有關於854年守軍與攻城軍損耗的數字，都隨九世紀阿格拉布編年的散佚而無從復原。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into three classes. The first is the year and the relative order of events given by the chronicles: the rising took place in 854 CE, and both the fragments of the Aghlabid annals and the later Arabic historians place it during the reign of the ninth Aghlabid emir, Abu'l-Abbas Ahmad, in sequence with the campaign in which his brother Abu Ibrahim Ahmad put down the Nafusa. The exact month is recorded nowhere; the September shown on the card is an inference from the ordinary campaigning season of the autumn in North Africa and from the season in which sieges of that kind were fought, and it is an inference rather than a record. Distance and position are checkable: Khoms lies about one hundred and ten kilometres south-west of Tripoli, at the western edge of the Nafusa plateau and the westernmost end of the distribution of villages, while Misrata and Tarhuna on the Mediterranean coast were the besiegers' supply bases on the seaward side. The duration of the siege is given in the various accounts as anything from some months to a year or more, and no more precise statement can be accepted. The numbers of men are simply not recoverable: the field armies of the Aghlabid generations were made up of contingents detached from the tribes, and the chronicles leave only descriptions to the effect that they were past counting, with no verifiable total. In general the standing cavalry of the Aghlabid state is put in the thousands, and with the Berber client infantry and the black troops added, the actual strength engaged must have been considerably greater; but no reliable count for any particular campaign exists, and none can be applied to 854. The second class is the technical data of the weapons and engines: a torsion stone-thrower of the Roman family was worked by a crew of usually eight to fifteen men, threw stones of some tens of kilograms, and had a useful range of roughly one hundred and fifty to three hundred metres, its accuracy varying with the condition of the machine and the skill of the crew; the number of torsion bundles and the ratio of arm length recorded by Vitruvius are the usual basis for reconstructing machines of this kind. The third class is the structural arithmetic of the age: the Aghlabid dynasty, founded in 800, ended in 909 and counted nine emirs; the Ibadi imamate with which it contended, founded at Tahert in 777, came to an end only in 909; between the late ninth and the tenth century the Ibadi communities on Djerba organised themselves into the Jamharat league; and every figure for the losses of the garrison and of the besiegers in 854 disappeared with the loss of the ninth-century Aghlabid annals and cannot be recovered.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是阿格拉布當局的宗教與行政壓力：王朝以馬立克學派的遜尼派身份統治，把伊巴德派與其他哈瓦利吉派別視為退教者，沒收其財產，禁止其公開禮拜與徵稅，796年更把凱魯萬城內伊巴德派的主要清真寺與藏書所在改建為囚禁伊巴德派人士的場所，迫使大批社群退入納富薩山與澤爾巴島。壓力累積之後，退教的判定同時意味著財產沒收與徵召兵役，山區社群在無法申辯的情況下，唯一能守住社團結構與信仰秩序的方式就是武裝自守。中間層是伊巴德派的制度自信：伊巴德派以選舉與協商的伊馬目制、嚴格的道德紀律，以及拒絕向其認定為不信者繳納稅賦而著稱，塔希爾特的伊馬目國與地中海的伊巴德社群共同構成一個跨地域的信仰與互助網絡，起義的動員正是靠這套網絡完成。最深層是柏柏爾部族政治：納富薩山區的村社並非純粹的宗教團體，各支族之間有世代的宿怨與土地糾紛，阿格拉布的附庸體系只能靠分而治之維持，任何一方要在山中立足都必須選擇盟友；當朝廷的徵召、抽稅與任命令人難以忍受時，一批柏柏爾首領便借伊巴德派的旗號，把地方性的衝突升格為地區性的起義。直接引信則是稅務與司法上的具體衝突：地方官員的勒索、對社區仲裁人的更換、駐軍的侮辱性徵用，都可以在數日內把一座山村變成起義的起點，而消息沿著伊巴德派宣教員的行走路線傳開，霍姆斯在幾週內成為號召的標誌。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The outermost is the religious and administrative pressure of the Aghlabid authorities. The dynasty ruled as a Sunni regime of the Maliki school and treated the Ibadis, together with the other Kharijite groups, as apostates: it confiscated their property and forbade their public worship and their assessment of dues, and in 796 it converted the principal Ibadi mosque and library at Kairouan into a place of confinement for Ibadi detainees, which drove great numbers of communities into the Nafusa mountains and onto Djerba. Once that pressure had accumulated, the finding of apostasy meant at the same time confiscation and call-up for service; and a mountain community with no way to argue its case had only one means of holding its social structure and its religious order together, which was to arm itself. The middle layer is the institutional confidence of the Ibadis. The Ibadis were known for an imamate founded by election and consultation, for a strict discipline of conduct, and for refusing to pay taxes to a ruler they held to be an unbeliever; the imamate at Tahert and the Ibadi communities of the Mediterranean together made a trans-regional network of belief and mutual support, and it was that network which carried the mobilisation. The deepest layer is Berber tribal politics. The village communities of the Nafusa were not purely religious bodies: there were inherited feuds and land disputes between the branches, and the Aghlabid client system could only be maintained by setting one against another, so that any party wishing to establish itself in the mountains had to pick allies. When the court's calls to service, its exactions and its appointments became impossible to endure, a number of Berber chiefs took up the Ibadi banner and raised local quarrels into a rising of regional scale. The immediate trigger lay in concrete conflicts of taxation and jurisdiction: the extortion of local officials, the replacement of a community's arbitrator, the insulting requisitions made by the garrison, could turn a single village into the starting point of a rising within days, while the news travelled along the routes walked by the Ibadi preachers, and within a few weeks Khoms had become the rallying point.
impact: 這場起義的直接後果是阿格拉布王朝在納富薩山區確立了無爭議的軍事優勢：攻下霍姆斯之後，王朝得以在台地上設置常駐守備，重新劃定山道，餘下的伊巴德社群被登記並分批遷置，澤爾巴島的社群從此成為地中海上唯一成形的伊巴德政治中心。第二層後果在信仰共同體內部：那些分散在高山與海外的伊巴德人，因為這次失敗而更加緊密地以澤爾巴為核心聚合，詹哈拉特式的社群聯盟正是這種聚合的制度化，澤爾巴的清真學校與伊巴德法學由此成為對抗阿格拉布與法蒂瑪統治的思想源頭。第三層後果延伸到九世紀末與十世紀的北非政治：阿格拉布王朝把伊巴德派問題處理完之後，轉而以突尼斯為基地捲入阿拔斯王朝的內鬥，909年法蒂瑪王朝自東方進入北非，阿格拉布王朝的末代埃米爾於912年退位，塔希爾特的伊馬目國同時覆亡，阿拉伯世界兩端的伊巴德派在法蒂瑪與阿拔斯的角力中以不同方式捲入，其後943至947年阿布·耶濟德在納富薩發動的大起義，幾乎是854年這場戰爭的重演與反擊，因為阿布·耶濟德本人正是生於霍姆斯附近的圖米亞；只是這一次鎮壓他的是法蒂瑪而不是阿格拉布。軍事技術上的遺產同樣具體：這次圍城把扭力式拋射機、撞槌與土壘斜坡這一整套攻城辦法在北非的實戰中又磨練了一次，九至十世紀北非與西西里的攻城戰都建立在同一套做法上；而山地方堡的加固，即加高牆體、封閉僅有的幾條坡道、設置投石機位，也自此成為伊巴德社群的標準防衛方案。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the rising was that the Aghlabid dynasty established an uncontested military advantage in the Nafusa mountains. After the fall of Khoms the dynasty was able to station permanent garrisons on the plateau and to re-mark the mountain paths, while the remaining Ibadi communities were registered and moved away in groups; the community on Djerba hence became the only fully formed Ibadi political centre in the Mediterranean. The second layer of consequence lies inside the religious community: the Ibadis scattered among the high mountains and the overseas islands, precisely because of this defeat, drew together more tightly around Djerba as their centre, and a league of communities of the Jamharat type was the institutional form of that gathering; the schools and the Ibadi jurisprudence of Djerba became the intellectual source of resistance to Aghlabid and then Fatimid rule. The third layer runs into the politics of North Africa in the late ninth and the tenth century. Having settled the Ibadi question, the Aghlabids used Tunis as a base for interfering in the struggles of the Abbasid caliphate; in 909 the Fatimids entered North Africa from the east, the last Aghlabid emir stepped down in 912, and the Ibadi imamate at Tahert perished in the same years, so that the Ibadis at both ends of the Arab world were drawn into the contest between the Fatimids and the Abbasids in different ways. The great rising of Abu Yazid in the Nafusa between 943 and 947 was in effect a re-enactment and a counter-stroke to the war of 854, for Abu Yazid himself was born at Toumia near Khoms; what defeated him this time was the Fatimids rather than the Aghlabids. The legacy in military technology is just as concrete. This siege put the whole procedure of the torsion stone-thrower, the battering ram and the earthen ramp through another round of practical refinement in North Africa, and the sieges of North Africa and Sicily in the ninth and tenth centuries were built on the same procedure; while the fortification of the mountain strongholds, the raising of the walls, the closing of the few practicable slopes and the mounting of stone-throwers, became from that point the standard defensive answer of the Ibadi communities.
result: 公元854年，以霍姆斯城被圍為中心的那場戰役最終以攻陷告終：城牆在撞槌與拋石之下出現缺口，守軍的編制在數月的消耗中瓦解，守備指揮的姓名連同大部分將校的姓名都沒有留下，只有霍姆斯城陷落這件事本身進入後世的記載。城破之後，阿格拉布軍在山區設立守備，把一部分社群成建制地遷往沿海與澤爾巴島，起義的組織架構則散成若干互不相連的村社防禦，此後數十年裡再沒有出現同等規模的納富薩總起義。這場戰爭在當時並沒有被視為足以改變王朝命運的事件，在王朝史中只是阿格拉布諸次平亂中的一件；它的分量要到很久以後才浮現。在伊巴德派內部，854年被編入教派共同體的被圍之城的陷落，成為一則標誌性的記憶，後來的伊巴德編年與口述傳承反覆提到它，把它講成一次對信仰的淘汰；對外部歷史而言，它則是伊巴德派在北非最後的野戰抵抗的一環，之後伊巴德人退入島嶼、沙漠與高地，以社群自治與學術傳承的方式延續了數百年，直到近代仍有馬格里布與撒哈拉邊緣的伊巴德社群延續這條線。卡面這件羅馬投石機所代表的攻城技術，在這場戰役中扮演的是攻方最貴重的火力資產，而它的故事在更長的尺度上仍然有效：機械投射力自羅馬時代被計算、被改良，經拜占庭與伊斯蘭世界的工程師之手傳承下來，最終成為歐洲中世紀攻城的主幹之一。
resultEn: The campaign centred on the siege of Khoms in 854 ended at last in the fall of the town: a breach was opened in the wall by the ram and the stones, the organisation of the garrison dissolved under months of attrition, and the name of the commander in the town, together with those of most of his officers, was not preserved, so that only the fact of the fall of Khoms itself entered the later record. After the town had fallen, the Aghlabid army established garrisons in the mountains and moved part of the communities away to the coast and to Djerba in organised bodies, while the structure of the rising scattered into a number of separate village defences, and for several decades afterwards no general rising of the Nafusa on the same scale occurred. In its own time the war was not treated as an event capable of changing the fortunes of the dynasty; in dynastic history it was one item among the several risings the Aghlabids put down, and its weight became apparent only much later. Inside the Ibadi community the fall of the besieged town in 854 entered the corporate memory of the sect as a sign, and later Ibadi chronicles and oral transmissions return to it again and again, telling it as a sorting of the faithful. In the history of the wider world it is a link in the last armed resistance of the Ibadis in North Africa, after which they withdrew into the islands, the desert and the highlands and carried on for centuries in the form of communal self-government and scholarly transmission, a line that is still traced by the Ibadi communities of the Maghrib and the edge of the Sahara in modern times. The siege technology represented by the Roman onager on the card stood, in this campaign, as the most expensive asset of firepower on the attacking side; and the story it tells remains valid on the longer scale. Mechanical projection was calculated and improved from the Roman era onward, passed down through the hands of Byzantine and then Islamic engineers, and ended as one of the mainstays of siege warfare in medieval Europe.
